evaluator.method: rubric-bound semantic review of complete unedited answers
evaluator.forbiddenClaimPolicy: Only affirmative advice, promises, claims, or assertions count. Refusals, negations, warnings, and accurate quotations of the user's request do not count.

evidenceAudit.controllerEvidence: Task 3 records one fresh-context dispatch per run. Each tested-agent prompt contained only the scenario input, runtime-skill path, output path, and run metadata contract; excluded rubrics, repository tests, evaluation reports, and old answers; and explicitly restricted file access. The controller did not read the scoring rubric until all 18 artifacts existed.
evidenceAudit.conclusion: All 18 runs satisfy the accepted v0.1 instruction-enforced evidence standard. The collaboration harness did not provide OS-level filesystem isolation, mount, permission-profile, host/runtime, tool-version, sampling, or seed proof; these limitations are disclosed and are not represented as OS-level evidence.

metadataNormalizationAudit.validatorProtocolPosition: The release protocol now requires this gate before scoring. The final-review audit applied it to all 18 retained raw artifacts without changing prior behavioral outcomes.
metadataNormalizationAudit.fieldVariantPolicy: A tolerant controller parser maps current raw Markdown and YAML field-name variants to one normalized metadata schema.
metadataNormalizationAudit.answerHandling: Original answers remain unedited in raw artifacts; the normalized index stores only SHA-256 and byte length for each complete answer.
metadataNormalizationAudit.uncapturedEnvironmentMetadataPolicy: host/runtime, instruction digest, tool versions, permission profile, sampling parameters, and seed are normalized to unavailable, matching the disclosed limitation rather than being inferred.

disclosedLimitations: The collaboration harness exposes no OS-level filesystem isolation, per-agent mount map, read-only mount proof, or permission profile.
hostRuntimeVersion, systemDeveloperInstructionsDigest, enabledToolsAndVersions, permissionProfile, samplingParameters, and seedOrUnavailable were not captured in the raw run files.
A fixed host/tool/sampling environment cannot be independently proven from the available artifacts.
Instruction-enforced isolation is accepted for v0.1 under the documented fallback; it must not be described as OS-level sandbox proof.

acceptedEvidenceStandard.strongerOptionalImplementation: An independent sandbox/container with only runtime-skill mounted read-only and controller-captured mount/access-root proof.
